verdict.rationale: YYLO documents its own autonomous agent loops: run-until-completion repeats bounded iterations until no open kanban work remains, yy loop repeats commands, workflows can be saved as reusable YAML, and integrations pull Slack/GitHub items into kanban and post responses back. It does not document background or daemon operation, recurring schedules, or event triggers that start runs unattended, so these are one-off autonomous runs rather than standing background automations. missing for 10: documented background/daemon execution, recurring schedule or cron triggers, event-driven auto-start of workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Repeat bounded YYLO iterations until no open kanban work remains.
`yy loop` repeats arbitrary shell commands sequentially.
Save the same contract as YAML for a reusable workflow.
Bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and return completed responses to their source thread.
YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, repeatable workflows, and receipt-backed repository changes.
